name: Randal Anderson
source:
"Hell if I know, heheh."

Randal is a quiet, private security guard who is supposed to watch the camera feed and walk rounds, but sleeps and drinks in his office instead. Though he's solitary, he does appreciate company and talking about what Westerns he's seen.

[From [url=https://thugzilla.itch.io/object-ward]Itch.io[/url]]
